$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. How a release reads on the changelog, shaped after Preline's (Zafar, 17 Sep 2026, pointing at preline.co/docs/changelog.html): a title, then chips (an icon and a label, like Preline's "New Components & Improvements" and "Fixes and Improvements"), each followed by its items with a bold lead ("People:", "Layout:") and the drawings the item is about. His asks on the way: "topic > icons, topic > icons. not all topics first and then all icons after that", "categorize them, not just text > icons. titles, etc.", "redrawns deserve to be a separate topic, not within a topic and each subtitle must carry shareable link like the main titles". So redraws are always their own chip. Per version: `title` (the release's headline, which every version has, released ones included, because the page heads each entry by it) and optionally `sections`: chips with `title`, `icon` (a drawing from this set, by name), `text`, and items in `sections` with `title`, `text`, `names` (added) or `redraws`. A version with no `sections` is drawn with default chips, New drawings and Redrawn, straight off git. pipeline/build-history.mjs gives every chip and item an `anchor` (v<version>-<chip>, v<version>-<chip>-<item>) that the site links, keeps only the drawings the entry carries, and appends anything no item claims in a last untitled group, reported, so a stale list never drops a drawing. Keyed by the version the work ships as, so nothing is re-keyed at the tag. Numbers go in as {names} and {files}. Where a version has sections they replace the note.

1.0.0.title: 1,000 icons in stroke, two-tone, duotone and fill, each rounded and sharp: 8,000 total

sections.title: Four styles
sections.text: Every name now comes in four styles, stroke, two-tone, duotone and fill, and each style in two corner shapes, rounded and sharp: {files} SVGs across {names} names. The outlined duotone is called two-tone from this release, so an import of duotone that wants the old look changes to two-tone. Duotone is a new style with no outline, a grey body with the part that matters in black, drawn icon by icon.

sections.title: People
sections.text: A new shelf for the boy, the girl, a baby with a curl, one with a bow, and both babies again with a pacifier.

sections.title: Layout
sections.text: The panels gain their close, open and dashed forms on every side, three split layouts and a table.

sections.title: Devices
sections.text: The phone takes call, incoming, outgoing, missed and forwarded. The tablet takes its upright form and the phone's eight signs, a laptop arrives and sits beside a phone. A watch, a hard drive, a cable and a headset visor join them, and a phone casts. An app window takes a plus, a minus, an x and a cursor beside its ruled form, a CCTV camera watches with and without a slash, a mouse arrives, and a shredder takes a page.

sections.title: Finance
sections.text: Two banknotes carry a check, minus, plus and x, and a wallet holds its cards.

sections.title: Time
sections.text: The alarm clock takes a check, plus and minus, beside a stopwatch and its reset.

sections.title: Transport
sections.text: A rocket climbs on its flame, trails speed lines and stands upright, and a car drives past in profile.

sections.title: Pointers
sections.text: A closed hand and an open hand join the pointer.

sections.title: Arrows
sections.text: The big arrows point four ways, long and short, and a clockwise turn takes a plus.

sections.title: Text
sections.text: The heading comes with its six levels, beside the case marks, an outlined T and a whole word.

sections.title: Mail
sections.text: The round and the square bubble take a sparkle, and send takes a clock.

sections.title: Media
sections.text: A screen takes AirPlay, a film camera rolls its reels, a mast broadcasts, a radio tunes in, and sound gets a search.

sections.title: Users
sections.text: A person speaks, contacts and an ID card carry a portrait, and the accessibility figure stands in its ring. A fingerprint and an incognito hat with dark glasses join them.

sections.title: Actions
sections.text: A shield takes a key, a siren sounds, and delete clears a character.

sections.title: Controls
sections.text: Two switches, one on and one off.

sections.title: Charts
sections.text: A gauge reads its dial.

sections.title: Maps
sections.text: A map pin carries a heart, and a milestone points the way.

sections.title: Commerce
sections.text: A shopping basket, a paper bag and a shirt.

sections.title: Stationery
sections.text: A sticky note takes a check, a minus, a plus, an x and a slash, and two of them stack.

sections.title: Art
sections.text: A swatch book fans its colours.

sections.title: Weather
sections.text: A snowflake, wind and humidity, two clouds, and a cloud over the sun and over the moon.

sections.title: Web
sections.text: The earth, the Americas and Africa on a globe.

sections.title: Nature
sections.text: Three arrows chase round to recycle.

sections.title: AI
sections.text: The bot takes a slash, and a brain turns a cog.

sections.title: Files
sections.text: A zipped folder, a folder tree, a file takes a search and a type mark, whole or in its corner, and a pen writes with sparkles.

sections.title: Redrawn
sections.text: Drawings that already shipped and were drawn again, each shown before and after.

sections.title: Layout
sections.text: The four dashed close panels sit their grey under the frame's round corners, and the grid fills keep 2 units clear of their edges.

sections.title: Devices
sections.text: In two-tone scan-eye greys its frame, scan-search's handle starts on its ring, and monitor-off's far side stands off the slash as far as every other -off does.

sections.title: Finance
sections.text: The coins sit on rounder faces with 2 units between every coin.

sections.title: Pointers
sections.text: The pointer is drawn again in all four directions, and its fill carries the finger lines.

sections.title: Files
sections.text: The file fills cut their folded corner clear of the edge, and the paperclip runs longer.

sections.title: Charts
sections.text: In two-tone the charts grey their axes and keep the data in black.

sections.title: Media
sections.text: The gallery frames take a tighter radius, and play is smaller.

sections.title: Actions
sections.text: The three dots are larger, and the sparkle's tips reach the same 2-unit margin as everything else.

sections.title: Shapes
sections.text: The dice take larger pips, and in two-tone circle-progress-play greys the part still to play.

sections.title: Web
sections.text: In two-tone globe-off greys its far side.
